steps: 1. Use **Waystalker** and her native **Spear**, in the **Primary melee** slot. Keep its normal moveset; do not use Spear and Shield, a borrowed weapon/carrier, or a new reciprocal style. Record any Weapon Tweaker/history/tweak setup already active; this test does not assume pristine settings.
2. After equipping and leaving inventory, switch to your ranged weapon, then back to the Spear. This arms the actual wield-context cache.

3. Perform one complete light-attack chain, each heavy attack’s wind-up/hold/release, block/hold/release, push, and push attack. Record the order and any visibly missing or stuck animation; avoid endless repeats.
4. Exit normally and attach the newest **full console log** with your career, weapon, setup, and observations.

5. Optional, only if already legitimately available: repeat in a **separate fresh game session**, using **Mercenary or Huntsman**, native **Tuskgor Spear**, and **Hunter Combat Style** only, in Primary melee. Repeat the ranged-to-melee swap and actions above. Do not select Infantry Combat Style or Tuskgor-on-Elf; no DLC purchase is required for this invitation.
